contribution_requirements_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md documents the development setup, how to run tests, commit style and review requirements: https://github.com/OWASP/VulnReach/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
version_semver_justification: Releases use semantic versioning (v1.0.1, v1.0.2, v2.0.1, v3.0.0); v3.0.0 is a major bump for a breaking CLI change: https://github.com/OWASP/VulnReach/releases
report_tracker_justification: Bugs and feature requests are tracked in GitHub Issues: https://github.com/OWASP/VulnReach/issues
report_archive_justification: GitHub Issues and pull requests form a public, searchable archive of reports and responses: https://github.com/OWASP/VulnReach/issues?q=is%3Aissue
vulnerability_report_process_justificati: SECURITY.md describes how to report vulnerabilities, what to include and the response timeline: https://github.com/OWASP/VulnReach/blob/main/SECURITY.md
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: SECURITY.md directs reporters to GitHub private vulnerability reporting (draft security advisory), with email as a fallback: https://github.com/OWASP/VulnReach/blob/main/SECURITY.md
static_analysis_justification: Ruff (FLOSS, pyflakes + pycodestyle rules E4/E7/E9/F) runs on every push and pull request in the CI lint job: https://github.com/OWASP/VulnReach/blob/main/.github/workflows/ci.yml
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: The CI static analysis (ruff E/F rules) checks correctness, not vulnerability patterns. Enabling a security-focused ruleset (e.g. ruff's flake8-bandit S rules) is planned.
static_analysis_fixed_justification: The ruff CI job must pass before merge, so findings are fixed before changes land.
static_analysis_often_justification: Ruff runs in CI on every push and pull request.
dynamic_analysis_justification: The test suite (pytest) runs in CI on every change, but no fuzzer or other dynamic analysis tool is applied to VulnReach itself yet.
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: VulnReach is written in Python, a memory-safe language.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: No dynamic analysis tool is used yet (see dynamic_analysis).
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: No dynamic analysis tool is applied to VulnReach yet, so there are no such findings to fix.
crypto_keylength_justification: The JWT HMAC-SHA-256 key (JWT_SECRET) must be at least 32 bytes (256 bits); shorter keys are rejected at runtime (api/auth.py). bcrypt uses a fixed 192-bit output.
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: pip-audit reports no known vulnerabilities in the pinned requirements.txt as of v3.0.0+; python-jose (no fix available) was replaced with PyJWT.
